zone_resolution.for_coder: A map may be listed in several zones (shared interiors: heal_brookhollow, shop_int, H1-H4 homes, rt_branch_backroom, their 2F maps). zone() = the zone whose maps list holds the outdoor map of the door the player came in by (lastDoor.map); on 2F/back-room maps follow the $return chain to that outdoor door first. Unique maps are listed once.
